Les mots du parent en anglais (luminous, ethereal, mellifluous, serendipity, erudite, euphoria) avec un exemple. Sophia au milieu sur erudite comme chez le parent (cta B). CTA : cta A = dernier item, à la première personne ; cta B = au milieu du deck, sur un fait ou une histoire ; cta C = l'appli comme rituel à la place du scroll (« an app like Sophia »). words that everyone should use

luminous

softly glowing, full of light.

her smile was luminous.

ethereal

extremely delicate, almost
heavenly.

the music had an ethereal sound.

mellifluous

sweet and smooth to hear.

he had a mellifluous voice.

erudite

highly educated, deeply read.

she sounded erudite on
every topic.
